name: Leadway Technology Investment Group Limited
summary: Leadway Technology Investment Group Limited operates as an investment holding entity primarily engaged in the creation, production, and distribution of smart card technologies, including associated software and hardware. The company boasts a global presence, catering to markets in the People's Republic of China, the United States, Germany, the Russian Federation, Turkey, and the Philippines, among other international regions. Beyond its core offerings, it provides various services related to smart cards and focuses on engineering and delivering solutions for automated revenue collection. Founded in 1995, the firm's headquarters are situated in Kowloon Bay, Hong Kong. In July 2022, the company underwent a name change, adopting its current identity from its former appellation, HNA Technology Investments Holdings Limited. Leadway Technology Investment Group Limited is presently a part of the HNA EcoTech Pioneer Acquisition group.
